scope.version_rule: Every supported version lane inherits the disposition of its exact Registry operation name.
scope.normal_input_rule: The Operation Registry exposes one normal input mode per operation and version. The Agent never chooses between Composer and Legacy JSON for one normal request.
scope.native_uri_rule: A shared native URI never implies a shared migration decision. Isolation is keyed by exact operation name and version.

waves.purpose: Freeze two structurally different reference Adapters and the shared Draft-to-Preview lifecycle.
isolation_regressions: All non-member input-mode lanes remain exact
object.setRTPC and object.createPlugin remain exact-name isolated despite sharing the object.set native URI
Legacy archive replay remains valid
waves.minimum_real_evidence: Weather, Rifle, Footsteps, and Weapons on Wwise 2022.1 and 2025.1 on macOS and native Windows; every failure remains a failure rather than coverage credit.

waves.purpose: Migrate one-target scalar, metadata-backed property/reference, and platform-link edits through a small-target Adapter family.
isolation_regressions: Each operation retains its own fields and verifier
null reference clearing stays distinct from omission
platform linking never becomes an ordinary property edit
waves.minimum_real_evidence: One real mutation per distinct verifier shape, including Alarm object.setReference on both integration versions and both hosts; version-only behavior runs on its matching real Wwise version.

waves.purpose: Migrate plug-in topology and RTPC curves without collapsing their separate contracts.
isolation_regressions: createPlugin and setRTPC remain distinct from object.set despite their shared native URI
replace-owned-root authority stays confined to object.create
delete retains protected-object and GUID-absence checks
RTPC points stay dedicated
waves.minimum_real_evidence: Weather object.create and object.setRTPC on both integration versions and hosts, plus matching real-host cases for createPlugin and delete verification.

waves.purpose: Migrate recursive create, protected delete, copy, and move with exact identity and parent/path verification.
isolation_regressions: recursive create keeps replace-owned-root authority
delete retains protected-object and GUID-absence checks
copy requires a returned new GUID under the requested parent
move requires the returned source GUID under the requested parent
waves.minimum_real_evidence: Five-version deterministic verifier fixtures plus representative real-host lifecycle validation at the release gate.

waves.purpose: Migrate the exact child-to-state-or-switch relationship through a dedicated relational Adapter.
isolation_regressions: Assignments never route through object.set or object.setReference
identity precision is preserved
add and remove retain opposite preconditions and verifiers
waves.minimum_real_evidence: Footsteps assignment workflows on Wwise 2022.1 and 2025.1 on macOS and native Windows with exact relationship readback.

waves.purpose: Migrate SoundBank inclusion, generation, definition-file, and external-source workflows while retaining host-path and isolated-I/O authority.
isolation_regressions: No path escapes the sealed I/O root
setInclusions remains a project mutation while generators retain artifact verification
platform and language limits remain operation-specific
Windows drive, UNC, junction, reparse, Unicode, and space cases remain explicit
waves.minimum_real_evidence: Harbor setInclusions and generate on both integration versions and hosts, matching real-host evidence for each file-processing verifier, and native-Windows filesystem security probes.

waves.purpose: Migrate Authoring-only UI commands and capture without treating packaged inventory snapshots as runtime authority.
isolation_regressions: Every route still requires Authoring
fresh getCommands remains authoritative
register and unregister ownership is not inferred
capture stays inside its I/O boundary
waves.minimum_real_evidence: A matching real Authoring host exercises every distinct UI side effect and verifier; native Windows evidence covers command transport and output paths.

waves.purpose: Migrate the bounded multi-call Undo Group after its intended child call families have stable typed inputs.
isolation_regressions: Nested calls cannot bypass manifests
one outcome produces one Preview
begin/end/cancel failures remain terminal and non-retryable
inner result and timeout ceilings remain Gateway-owned
waves.minimum_real_evidence: Successful and reviewed cancellation/failure shapes on matching real Wwise versions, then macOS and native-Windows fresh-Agent evidence for one representative compound outcome.

exceptions.reason: The user supplies an already serialized strict UTF-8 file. A Draft would wrap rather than eliminate that external composition boundary; retain explicit Legacy pending a dedicated file-workflow decision.
These routes execute exact user-supplied source under source-authority and I/O controls. The Agent must not compose or repair code, so mutation composition does not address their governing risk.
These small host/debug controls include deliberate crash and assertion routes. Confirmation and terminal outcomes dominate JSON ergonomics, so migration requires a separate risk decision.
This manifest-registered compatibility substrate spans heterogeneous reviewed functions. A generic Composer would recreate raw args/options composition and conflict with operation-specific Adapters.

legacy_exit_gates.requirement: Every Registry operation/version lane is Composer-complete, covered by an approved exception decision, or remains an explicit unimplemented exclusion.
Normal schema, detail, Skill guidance, and semantic protocols expose exactly one Registry-selected input mode; compatibility commands are never presented as an Agent choice.
Repository scripts, tests, docs, packaged continuations, maintainer-named external automation, and sealed archive replay consumers have been searched and their compatibility needs recorded.
Historical evidence remains replayable through a versioned compatibility parser or a separately reviewed migration tool before compatibility grammar is removed.
The final frozen Skill and semantic harness pass the complete public integration profile on macOS and native Windows; cumulative or failed roots remain reported as such.
A later decision ticket reviews actual consumer evidence and chooses retain or remove. This inventory neither authorizes removal nor creates a deletion implementation ticket.

second_round_ticketing.source_rule: Create implementation tickets one planned wave at a time after its action vocabulary and evidence cases are reviewed. Do not pre-split operation fields.
second_round_ticketing.dependency_rule: Cutover depends on Adapter and semantic support; real evidence depends on program and non-live gates. Legacy removal depends on every wave or approved exception plus every exit gate.
